Theme 3.Title: Self-Reflection and Awareness of Thought Patterns

Theme 4.Title: Reframing Negative Thoughts and Developing Coping Strategies

theme_relationships.explanation: Anxiety and self-doubt can lead to cognitive distortions and negative thought patterns.
Recognizing cognitive distortions can help mitigate their impact.
Self-reflection and awareness of thought patterns can facilitate reframing negative thoughts and developing coping strategies.
Reframing negative thoughts can help alleviate anxiety and self-doubt.
Reframing negative thoughts can help counteract cognitive distortions.
